messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look table of the **long weekends** that fall in Canada during 2023 (based on the federal holidays that create a 3‑day weekend).  
*(If a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, the adjacent weekend days automatically give you a long weekend. If the holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the observed day is usually the following Monday, which also creates a long weekend.)*

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|--------------|--------------|------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (Sunday) – observed Mon Jan 2 | 3‑day weekend (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |
| Family Day | **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Mon Feb 20) | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| Good Friday | **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday (Fri Apr 7) | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| Victoria Day | **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day (Mon May 22) | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| Canada Day | **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (Sat Jul 1) – observed Mon Jul 3 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| Labour Day | **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day (Mon Sep 4) | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving (Mon Oct 9) | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day (Sat Nov 11) – observed Mon Nov 13 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| Christmas | **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas Day (Mon Dec 25) | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |

> **Quick recap**  
> • 9 long weekends in 2023.  
> • All are based on federal holidays; provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day in Ontario vs. BC) may shift the exact dates slightly.  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, double‑check that province’s holiday calendar for any additional long weekends.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need the same info for another year or for a specific province, just let me know.
